# keel — Multi-Agent Workflow Core & Merge Coordinator

> keel turns AI coding agents into accountable work owners. It is an open-source,
> project-neutral multi-agent workflow core and merge coordinator that drives a
> GitHub issue from intake to done: select → branch → implement → CI → review →
> test → merge → close → capture. Projects set their values in `project.yaml` and
> snap their own logic into named extension slots. Stdlib-first Python CLI, single
> runtime dependency, 100% test coverage, 17 `/keel` commands, and high-concurrency
> multi-agent Swarm DAG orchestration.

## Documentation & Ecosystem

- [Home & Integrations Catalog](https://berkayturanci.github.io/keel/): overview, 32+ agent integrations (Claude, Cursor, Gemini, Codex, Devin, Ollama, DeepSeek)
- [Documentation](https://berkayturanci.github.io/keel/docs.html): commands, configuration, extension slots, Swarm DAG orchestration, and the fixed backbone
- [Test Coverage Report](https://berkayturanci.github.io/keel/coverage.html): live test-coverage dashboard (100% line + branch)

## Source & Distribution

- [GitHub Repository](https://github.com/berkayturanci/keel): source code, issues, releases, and discussions
- [Official GitHub Action](https://github.com/berkayturanci/keel-action): 1-click CI/CD action (`uses: berkayturanci/keel-action@v1`)
- [Homebrew Tap](https://github.com/berkayturanci/homebrew-keel): `brew install keel`
- [PyPI Package](https://pypi.org/project/keel-workflow/): `pipx install keel`

## Key Architecture & Features

- **Fixed Backbone (`s0`–`s12`)**: Invariant step sequence driving every issue from backlog to merge.
- **Project-Neutral Core**: All repo-specific configurations live in `.keel/project.yaml`.
- **High-Concurrency Swarm DAG**: Static scope disjointness analysis, parallel worktrees, and conflict self-healing rebase.
- **Single-Writer Merge Lock**: Safe, serial atomic PR landings without dirty checkouts.
- **Multi-Vendor AI Jury**: Independent 3-vendor review panel (Anthropic + OpenAI + Google) for unanimous pre-merge consensus.
- **Token Analytics & USD Cost Estimation**: Built-in pricing ledger via `keel cost-report`.
- **Post-Merge Canary Guard & Automated Rollback**: `keel canary` and `keel rollback` for zero-downtime safety.
- **Zero-Dependency Core**: Stdlib-first Python implementation with a strict 100% line & branch coverage bar.
